h: Torah Study and Delight Across the Worlds of Shabbos

p: It is stated in the Pesikta
and the one who says "for delight"
Now this needs to be understood:
אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁאַתֶּם עוֹשִׂין מְלָאכָה
Shabbos is to be made entirely Torah.
and go to the beis knesses
and afterward he shall go home
and from learning in the Prophets;
so what is the difference between them?
that they are free for Torah,
And this is the meaning of
what is written in the Tikkunim
the revelation of words of Torah
only in the aspect of delight,
which is from the aspect of Atika,
And this is the matter of
which is called the world of separation;
and a person is found in it
And they explained in the name of the Ramaz
that it refers to the body,
But this is difficult to say,
and it is forced to explain so;
and the body is not called "man,"
as is written in the holy Zohar
(פָּרָשַׁת יִתְרוֹ, חֵלֶק ב פו, רֵישׁ עַמּוּד א)
(Parshas Yisro, Zohar II 86a, top of the amud).
"and a person is found in it"
that is, when he is engaged
in words of Torah and prayer,
when he is engaged in the matters of the body,
And this is what it says:
"When they seek to gaze at it,
'Where is the place of His glory?'
בָּרוּךְ כְּבוֹד ה׳ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ (יְחֶזְקֵאל ג, יב)
'Blessed is the glory of Hashem from His place'" (Yechezkel 3:12),
in the manner of what they said
those who deal with the secret of the world
is the secret of the world.
So we see that the soul
is a mystery and a secret;
and this is the meaning of
And from this there is proof
and read the haftarah from a Prophet, etc.
for the World to Come in Gan Eden;
as a semblance of the World to Come,
that they are called "dwelling in the gardens";
"Shabbos is to be made entirely Torah."
as is written in Midrash Rabbah there.
the soul of the soul of man,
which is from the aspect of Atika;
over which there has not ruled
are as though dwelling in Gan Eden;
as a semblance of the World to Come,
And this is what they said,
as is written in the holy Zohar
